import os
import pytest
from pathlib import Path

# Import the public API that is expected to exist
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.types import UID
from doorstop.common import DoorstopError


@pytest.fixture
def temp_project(tmp_path):
    """Create a temporary Doorstop project root."""
    # Doorstop expects a root directory with a .doorstop folder
    root = tmp_path / ".doorstop"
    root.mkdir()
    return root


def test_U01_2__Use_Cases_Us__TC_001(temp_project):
    """
    Create a new requirement with formatting and identifiers
    """
    # Create a new document
    doc = Document.new(
        path=temp_project,
        prefix="DOC",
        sep=".",
        digits=2,
        auto=True,
    )
    # Create a new requirement item
    item = Item.new(
        name="New Requirement",
        text="This is a **new** requirement with *formatting* and identifiers.",
        parent=doc,
    )
    # Verify that the item was created
    assert item is not None
    # Verify that the item has a UID
    assert isinstance(item.uid, UID)
    # Verify that the UID prefix matches the document prefix
    assert item.uid.prefix == doc.prefix
    # Verify that the UID is unique (no other item in the document has the same UID)
    uids = {i.uid for i in doc.items}
    assert len(uids) == len(doc.items)
    # Verify that the text contains formatting markers
    assert "**new**" in item.text
    assert "*formatting*" in item.text


def test_U01_2__Use_Cases_Us__TC_002(temp_project):

    Attempt to create a requirement with an invalid identifier
    """

    with pytest.raises(DoorstopError):
        UID("DOC", "invalid")  # The second part should be numeric; this should raise
